title: Solid state structures and solution behaviour of tetranuclear lanthanide(III) carbonate-bridged coordination compounds of chiral 3 + 3 amine macrocycle

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: tetranuclear carbonate-bridged samarium(III) complex of the bis-deprotonated chiral 3+3 triphenolic hexaaza macrocycle

material_class.structural_family: carbonate-bridged tetranuclear dimer of dinuclear macrocyclic units

synthesis.procedure: Shared procedure for 1a–3a at the Ln(NO3)3/H3L^R/K2CO3/TMAH ratio 1.9:1:0.5:1.9 (other successful ratios 2:1:1:2 and 2:1:0.5:2). H3L^R·2.8CH3OH·2H2O (100.0 mg, 0.119 mmol) and Sm(NO3)3·6H2O (98.9 mg, 0.222 mmol) were dissolved in methanol (10 mL) and water (3 mL). A 25% methanolic TMAH solution (94 μL, 0.222 mmol) and 0.87 M aqueous K2CO3 (70 μL, 0.061 mmol) were added. The light green-yellow solution was stirred for 1 h at room temperature, concentrated on a rotary evaporator until a precipitate formed, stirred 10 min, filtered, washed three times with water/methanol (1:1, v/v), and dried under vacuum for 24 h. Single crystals of the more highly solvated form were grown by slow evaporation of the filtrate. The complex was first observed serendipitously by atmospheric CO2 fixation during prolonged evaporation of a basic Ln nitrate/macrocycle solution.

reagents.name: potassium carbonate
reagents.amount: 70 μL of 0.87 M aqueous solution, 0.061 mmol

synthesis.time: 1 h stirring, then 10 min after precipitation; vacuum drying 24 h
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction followed by rotary evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Precipitate filtered, washed with water/methanol (1:1, v/v), and dried under vacuum. Crystals grown by slow evaporation of the filtrate; crystals readily desolvate on drying.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: tetranuclear carbonate-bridged europium(III) complex of the bis-deprotonated chiral 3+3 triphenolic hexaaza macrocycle

material_class.structural_family: carbonate-bridged tetranuclear dimer of dinuclear macrocyclic units

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the same procedure as 1a using Eu(NO3)3·5H2O (95.2 mg, 0.222 mmol), H3L^R·2.8CH3OH·2H2O (100.0 mg, 0.119 mmol), 25% methanolic TMAH (94 μL, 0.222 mmol), and 0.87 M aqueous K2CO3 (70 μL, 0.061 mmol) in methanol (10 mL) and water (3 mL). The pale yellow solution was stirred 1 h at room temperature, concentrated until precipitation, stirred 10 min, filtered, washed three times with water/methanol (1:1), and dried under vacuum for 24 h. Crystals were grown by slow evaporation of the filtrate. An earlier prolonged evaporation of Eu(NO3)3/H3L^R/TEA (1:1:3 equiv.) in air also produced carbonate-bridged crystals by CO2 fixation.

reagents.name: potassium carbonate
reagents.amount: 70 μL of 0.87 M aqueous solution, 0.061 mmol

synthesis.time: 1 h stirring, then 10 min after precipitation; vacuum drying 24 h
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction followed by rotary evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Pale yellow precipitate filtered, washed with water/methanol (1:1, v/v), and dried under vacuum. Single crystals from slow evaporation of the filtrate.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: co-crystal of bis-deprotonated and fully deprotonated tetranuclear europium(III) carbonate-bridged macrocyclic complexes

material_class.structural_family: co-crystal of protonation isomers of a carbonate-bridged tetranuclear macrocyclic dimer

synthesis.procedure: No analytically pure bulk product was obtained when TEA was the base and tetramethylammonium bicarbonate the carbonate source. Slow evaporation of methanol–water solutions of Eu(NO3)3/H3L^R/TEA/TMAB in a 1.8:1:3:0.8 molar ratio afforded single crystals of the 1:1 co-crystal of the bis-deprotonated (2a) and fully deprotonated (2a') tetranuclear cations.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: slow evaporation of the reaction mixture
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Single crystals only; site occupancy 0.5 for each protonation state.
